study.title: Semantic Segmentation Using Deep Learning with Vegetation Indices for Rice Lodging Identification in Multi-date UAV Visible Images
study.short_title: Semantic Segmentation Using Deep Learning with Vegetation Indices for Rice Lodging Identification

dataset.name: UAV RGB images of rice paddies, Mozi Shield Park, Wufeng District, Taichung, Taiwan (Sony QX100 2017; DJI Phantom 4 Pro 2019)
dataset.note: 2017: 230 m flight, ~5.3 cm/pix; 2019: 200 m, ~5.5 cm/pix; 230 ha scouted, ~40 ha extracted for testing; each 5472x3648 image split into 3485 tiles of 480x480; 2082 train / 694 validation / 709 test. Labels: rice paddy, rice lodging, road, ridge, background.

mIoU.ambiguity: mIoU not reported; per-category precision/recall/accuracy/F1 and overall accuracy used.

F1.quote: The highest F1-score 83.56% and accuracy 94.43% is achieved by FCN-AlexNet using RGB information.
F1.ambiguity: F1-score for the rice lodging class on the 2017 testing dataset; abstract quotes 0.80 for 2017 validation.

PA.quote: Based on the results of the validation dataset, the highest accuracy of FCN-AlexNet reaches 91.24%, which is achieved by using RGB+ExGR information.
PA.ambiguity: Overall accuracy (91.24%) on validation dataset, FCN-AlexNet RGB+ExGR; note Tables 7/8 report class-level accuracy (94.43% rice lodging) rather than pixel OA.

crop_F1.ambiguity: Lodging-focused; rice paddy per-class F1 reported in Fig. 8 but not in crop-F1 benchmark form.

fps.ambiguity: Whole-test inference time 57-68 s reported (Table 7/8) on unspecified workstation; no FPS or edge hardware.

issues: Headline F1 aggregated from rice-lodging-class results; compute-time comparisons vs MLC, no edge metrics
